question: Solve: ((100.5)² - (79.2)²)/(100.5 + 79.2)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a² − b²) ÷ (a + b) = a − b

Here a = 100.5 and b = 79.2

So expression simplifies directly to 100.5 − 79.2

= 21.3

**∴ Answer = 21.3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

((100.5)² − (79.2)²) ÷ (100.5 + 79.2)

**Formula used:**

(a² − b²) = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ ((100.5 − 79.2)(100.5 + 79.2)) ÷ (100.5 + 79.2)

⇒ Cancel (100.5 + 79.2)

⇒ = 100.5 − 79.2

⇒ = 21.3

**∴ The correct answer is 21.3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares Identity

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Cancellation Rule

Common factors in numerator and denominator can be cancelled.

Simplification Trick

Recognizing identities avoids lengthy calculations.

Algebraic Identities Use

Common identities help reduce expressions quickly and accurately.
